content: {"like":["Video quality on Blu‑Ray is spectacular with rich, sparkling colors and clear brush‑stroke detail","Audio tracks remixed in Dolby Digital True HD, providing a great listening experience","Solid performances in the dub, especially Lisa Ortiz as Deedlit and other principal characters","The OVA’s presentation and restoration from original film negatives, making it the real star of the release","The inclusion of clean credit opening sequence and better previews placement in the extras","Overall entertainment value of the OVA remains timeless and highly enjoyable for fantasy fans"],"dislike":["TV series dub suffers from uneven acting, inconsistent lip‑sync, and many mediocre or bad performances","Cast changes in the TV dub, notably replacement of Lisa Ortiz for two episodes, which is distracting","The TV dub’s audio quality and directionality do not age as gracefully as the OVA’s","The price point of the set is high, especially since the TV series is only on DVD and not Blu‑Ray","Missing making‑of featurette from the DVD release and a lack of additional extras","The TV series animation quality is mediocre and does not benefit much from the transfer"]}
